0022600229.text: Minnesota hosts Dallas in the Timberwolves' 12th game of the season, and they come in at 8-3 (4-1 at home) on a four-game winning streak, sitting 2nd in the Northwest, 0.5 games back, and 5th in the West. Dallas arrives at 7-4 (2-2 on the road) on a three-game winning streak and 4th in the Southwest, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet, after the Timberwolves won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 124-94 in Dallas on March 30. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery; 33.3 points in 33.7 minutes per game this season) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a leg issue and a game-time decision.
